description: This file is a shell script that defines a test procedure to verify cloning a large Git repository (>2GB). It includes setup commands, conditional execution based on environment variables, and multiple clone tests including a bare clone and a clone with a worktree.

methods.name: test_bool_env
methods.description: Checks the environment variable GIT_TEST_CLONE_2GB to determine whether to run the large clone test.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for given commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
